title: Undecidability of nonlinear attractor membership
question: For an effectively encoded family of dissipative polynomial PDEs, determine whether membership of a rational initial state in a designated attractor basin is decidable.
first_test: Construct a uniform reduction from a known undecidable language or a terminating decision procedure.

title: Prediction hardness for reversible local waves
question: For a specified finite-alphabet reversible radius-one automaton, classify the complexity of predicting one cell after binary-encoded time.
first_test: Prove completeness for a precisely named complexity class or provide a faster simulation.

title: Uniform simulation overhead for local wave rules
question: Determine the minimal polynomial overhead for one fixed local update rule to emulate arbitrary bounded-tape Turing computations.
first_test: Prove explicit lower and upper overhead bounds under a uniform encoding.

title: Communication complexity of wave evolution
question: Partition initial data of a local wave cellular automaton between two observers and determine the minimum communication needed to predict a designated output.
first_test: Prove a communication lower bound or give a protocol.

title: Parallel prefix shortcuts for homogeneous wave rules
question: Identify reversible cellular automata whose T-step global evolution admits polylogarithmic-depth circuits.
first_test: Construct a uniform parallel algorithm and prove its correctness.

title: P-completeness of local-wave reachability
question: For a fixed finite-state wave automaton, decide whether reachability of a target pattern is P-complete under logspace reductions.
first_test: Give a full reduction or identify an easier decision class.

title: Precision complexity near unstable manifolds
question: Quantify how the input bits required for a certified prediction grow when trajectories approach a hyperbolic unstable set.
first_test: Prove a sharp dependence on Lyapunov rate and horizon.

title: Certified integration without global Lipschitz constants
question: Determine whether local a posteriori error bounds yield polynomial-time validated integration for a finite-dimensional nonlinear wave truncation.
first_test: Provide an algorithm with explicit complexity or an obstruction family.

title: Bit complexity of fourth-order spectral solvers
question: Establish upper and lower arithmetic complexity for certified resolvent computation on an N-by-N periodic spectral grid.
first_test: Prove precision-aware algorithmic bounds with stated conditioning assumptions.

title: Complexity of deciding discrete soliton existence
question: For a finite rational lattice energy, classify the complexity of deciding whether a nontrivial stable localized equilibrium exists below a rational energy level.
first_test: Prove NP-hardness or tractability in a frozen lattice family.

title: Memory lower bounds for reversible computation
question: Determine the minimal reversible workspace for simulating a prescribed finite-alphabet local wave rule without erasing information.
first_test: Prove a space-time tradeoff or exhibit a compact reversible interpreter.

title: Algorithmic verification of invariants
question: For polynomial wave-cell updates over a finite field, determine the complexity of deciding whether a supplied polynomial is a global invariant.
first_test: Construct an algebraic decision method or a hardness reduction.

title: Certified stopping rules for dissipative evolution
question: Determine whether a computable error certificate can always decide when a dissipative wave simulation has entered a chosen invariant neighborhood.
first_test: Prove termination under explicit spectral-gap promises or impossibility without them.

title: Circuit depth versus locality radius
question: For bounded-fan-in circuits simulating radius-r cellular updates, determine which information-light-cone arguments force depth and when algebraic shortcuts defeat them.
first_test: Prove sharp depth bounds for a chosen rule family.

title: Noise tolerance of universal wave automata
question: For a universal cellular rule with independent symbol noise per step, determine whether fault-tolerant simulation is possible with polynomial overhead.
first_test: Construct an error-correcting simulation or prove breakdown under a fixed noise model.

title: Computable stability radius
question: Given rational coefficients of a discretized wave energy and a rational equilibrium, determine whether the largest guaranteed perturbation radius can be approximated to arbitrary precision.
first_test: Provide an effective modulus or an undecidability reduction.

title: Formal complexity of proof-producing simulation
question: Quantify the cost of producing and checking a proof certificate for each step of a rational wave evolution.
first_test: Establish asymptotic proof-size upper bounds and a matching adversarial family.

title: Resource-bounded equivalence of wave models
question: Determine whether two fixed finite-state local wave models simulate each other with polynomially bounded time and space overhead.
first_test: Construct uniform compilers in both directions or prove a separation under specified resources.

title: Complexity of exact spectral gap detection
question: For a family of rational sparse Hermitian matrices derived from wave lattices, classify the complexity of deciding whether a designated rational spectral gap is positive.
first_test: Prove a promise-problem classification using an explicit encoding.

title: Thermodynamic cost versus computational depth
question: In an explicitly driven noisy finite-state wave device, determine whether low-depth computation imposes a nontrivial minimum expected dissipated work.
first_test: Prove a time-energy-error tradeoff or an admissible reversible counterprotocol.
